rows.textLatex:

  5. How can ROM be used as PLD?

  7. What is an ASIC?
  8. What are the different logic states available in VHDL as per IEEE standard?

rows.topic: Short answer — any THREE on 8051 platform
rows.textLatex:
Answer any Three of the following questions on 8051 platform:

a) Write bit-format of the register SCON along with the functions of each of its bits. Hence, write a program segment to configure serial port for continuous transmission of data at a Baud rate of 19200. Comments are not necessary against the segment of program.

b) Write the names of SFRs that are used partially or fully for configuring interrupts and running interrupt related routines. State the bit-format of any one of such SFRs and explain the functions of all the bits of the SFR.

c) Mention the names of three pins that are used to interface external code memories. Draw neatly an appropriate schematic diagram showing such interface.

d) Write a complete mnemonic to perform each of the following tasks:
(i) store the content of accumulator into an external data memory
(ii) store the content of R0 of bank-1 into a location of stack memory
(iii) configure port-1 as input port
(iv) decrement R2 until it is zero
(v) jump relative by 34H if the addressable bit 06H is '1'
(vi) detect "divide by zero error"

e) Describe the on-chip memory map of the microcontroller.

rows.topic: 8051: Blink LED at 400 Hz using Timer-0
rows.textLatex:
Write a program to blink LED at a frequency of 400Hz using timer-0. The following conditions are to be considered.
(i) The on-time of the LED should be 80% of its off-time.
(ii) The light will continue to blink as long as INT0 pin is high.
(iii) The LED is connected to P3.5 of the microcontroller 8051.
(iv) The microcontroller runs on 10MHZ clock.
Explain your solution.
Write the names of alternate functions of port-3.

Write short notes on any two:

i) Priorities of interrupt and their alterations
ii) Addressing modes of 8051
(iii) Assembler directives

The START and STOP switches of a motor are connected to pins P1.0 and P1.1 of an 8051 microcontroller. A seven segment display is connected to the pins of P3 of the microcontroller. Write a program to ensure the following operations:
(i) After the START switch is pressed, '1' is displayed for 1 second.
(ii) Then, 'c' is displayed as long as motor continues to run.
(iii) After the STOP switch is pressed, '0' is displayed until the motor is started again.
Explain your solution.

Write the name(s) of the flag(s) and the way they are affected by the following instructions:
(i) DIV AB
(ii) SUBB
(iii) CJNE
